notes.title: New free game! Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1036950/ss_4637cfdf98aaac02d1f34cb1449cec2047ece0e6.1920x1080.jpg?t=1554376368

Greetings! We are happy to announce the release of our new FREE game! Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations!

30 free puzzles and more added each month! 4 difficulties, rotation, zoom, puzzles up to 800 pieces!

Also if you like it we have many puzzle packs, now at 20% discount!

And you can buy all the packs in a bundle up to an additional 50% discount! Isn't that amazing?

Just relax and make puzzles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036950/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Generations/

notes.title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime now available!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/972430/ss_dd71c6dbf014cb5737e7c0060f8cdca46bce93f5.1920x1080.jpg?t=1542059863

Hi guys! We are happy to announce the release of our new special game of the Super jigsaw Puzzle series, Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime! 

Make puzzles of beautiful anime images! Kawaii! 30 puzzles in 5 difficulties, now with rotation and puzzles up to 800 pieces! And just for the launch we have a 40% discount!

And remember that you can buy all the games in a bundle with an additional 30% discount, even if you have the other games already!

Just relax and make puzzles!

notes.title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Space new translations!
notes.content:
Hello guys! We are happy to announce that we added two new translations to Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Space: japanese and portuguese!

Now if you are from Japan, Brazil or Portugal you can play your favorite jigsaw puzzle game in your own language. Yay!

Thank you for your support and remember that you can buy all 4 games in the series with a 25% discount!

Just relax and make puzzles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/792650/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/862110/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Cities/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/878250/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Monuments/
